name: Curiosity Killed the Night
source:
A home once bought to cradle a new love now buries it beneath secrets soon to be uncovered.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当初买下这个家，是为了让一段刚萌芽的爱情在这里生长。如今，这份爱却被埋在了这个家即将揭开的重重秘密之下。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
